headline: NEW FOUND GOLD DELIVERS 23.7 G/T AU OVER 15.88M AT LOTTO CHANNEL — 43.5 g/t Underground; 210m Exposed Strike at Queensway Validates Block Model (TSXV: NFG)
snippet: New Found Gold Corp. (TSXV: NFG, NYSE: NFGC) released Lotto Zone channel sample and infill drill results from its Queensway Gold Project in Newfoundland: surface channels across a 210-metre excavated strike returned 23.7 g/t Au over 15.88m (including 164.7 g/t Au over 2.11m) while underground infill drilling returned 43.5 g/t Au over 4.75m and 22.3 g/t Au over 3.60m — results President Melissa Render stated are fully consistent with the existing MRE block model. With 40,100m now completed in 284 holes and an updated Queensway technical report planned for H2 2026, the Lotto data confirm that published grade estimates are holding at the drill bit in one of Newfoundland's most closely watched advanced-stage gold projects.

headline: EQUINOX GOLD SHAREHOLDERS VOTE TODAY ON ORLA ALL-SHARE MERGER — Creates Canada's Next 1M+ Oz/Yr Producer; ISS, Glass Lewis Both Recommend Yes (TSX: EQX, ORLA)
snippet: Equinox Gold Corp. (TSX: EQX) is holding its special shareholder meeting today, July 22, to vote on an all-share acquisition of Orla Mining Ltd. (TSX: ORLA) — a deal that, if approved, would create one of Canada's largest senior gold producers with over one million ounces of projected 2026 production by combining Equinox's multi-asset Latin American portfolio with Orla's high-margin Camino Rojo mine in Zacatecas, Mexico. Both ISS and Glass Lewis have recommended voting in favour, key Canadian regulatory clearances are already in hand, existing Equinox shareholders would own approximately 67% of the enlarged group, and closing is targeted for Q3 2026 with Equinox retaining its name and dual TSX/NYSE American listing.

headline: BC APPROVES MOUNT POLLEY TAILINGS DAM TO 987M ELEVATION — Mine Life Extended to 2034; Imperial Also Reports Q2 on Track and 22 Huckleberry Cu-Mo Drill Holes (TSX: III)
snippet: British Columbia's ministers of Mining and Environment approved an amendment raising Mount Polley's tailings dam from the previously permitted 974-metre to 987-metre elevation, providing storage capacity through 2034 and removing a key operational overhang for Imperial Metals Corp. (TSX: III) — announced the same day the company reported Q2 2026 production tracking within full-year guidance. Separately, 22 diamond drill holes totalling 7,047 metres at the wholly owned Huckleberry copper-molybdenum mine in central BC intersected continuous copper, molybdenum, silver, and gold mineralisation in the Main Zone southwest extension and a molybdenum trend defined by historic blast holes, with assays pending.

headline: SILVER HOLDS ABOVE $60 AS FOMC MINUTES DROP TODAY — Gold Steady Near $4,080; July 29 Fed Decision Now Priced at 89% Probability of Hold
snippet: Silver extended its two-day recovery rally above $60 per ounce on Wednesday and gold held near $4,080 as markets awaited today's FOMC minutes — the first to reflect the committee's publicly-documented 9-to-8 hawk-dove split — ahead of the July 29 Federal Reserve policy decision, where CME FedWatch now assigns 89% probability to rates remaining unchanged at 4.25%-4.50%. The precious metals complex has recovered sharply from its mid-July six-month low after oil-driven inflation fears subsided and June CPI printed softer-than-expected at 3.5% year-on-year — the largest monthly deflation since April 2020.

headline: PUMA DRILLS 42.60 G/T AU IN INAUGURAL McKENZIE HOLES — High-Grade Vein System Confirmed Over 5-to-20m Envelopes in New Brunswick (TSXV: PUMA)
snippet: Puma Exploration Inc. (TSXV: PUMA) confirmed the high-grade vein system at the RIM Gold Zone of the McKenzie Gold Project in Northern New Brunswick with results from its inaugural 2,721-metre diamond drilling program: quartz vein structures returned 42.60 g/t Au over 0.25m, 21.86 g/t Au over 0.30m, and 15.55 g/t Au over 0.30m — narrow bonanza veins hosted within broader 5-to-20-metre lower-grade envelopes consistent with the project's characteristic vein-hosted gold style. Results will guide fall 2026 drilling targets as the company advances what it calls one of New Brunswick's most prospective emerging gold systems.

headline: NEXGOLD EXPANDS GOLDBORO INFILL DRILL TO 40,000M — Q3 2026 Feasibility Study On Track as Nova Scotia Project Advances Engineering and Earthworks (TSX: NEXG)
snippet: NexGold Mining Corp. (TSX: NEXG) expanded its Goldboro Gold Project RC infill drill program from 30,000 to 40,000 metres — now approximately 62% complete — while simultaneously advancing engineering design, early earthworks, procurement, and key personnel recruitment toward an updated Mineral Resource Estimate and Feasibility Study targeted for Q3 2026. The Nova Scotia project continues to validate near-surface high-grade gold (earlier results included 61.22 g/t over 12.0m and 5.85 g/t over 13.0m during infill drilling) and a positive feasibility outcome would set the stage for a construction decision at one of Atlantic Canada's most advanced gold development projects.

headline: WARSH SAT OUT THE DOT PLOT — FOMC MINUTES DROP TODAY: What a 9-to-8 Committee Split Means for Gold's Next Move Above or Below $4,100
snippet: GoldSilver.com examines a rarely-discussed procedural development: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh abstained from the June dot plot — an unusual move that left a published 9-to-8 hawkish committee split without a corresponding rate action to validate it, keeping gold range-bound between $4,000 and $4,100. With today's FOMC minutes releasing and July 29's decision a week away, the analysis argues the sole variable that matters for gold is whether Warsh's post-meeting commentary reaffirms September hike optionality (capping gold near $4,000) or quietly walks back the hawkish posturing and clears the path to $4,200 and beyond.

headline: GOLD'S STRUCTURAL CASE INTACT AFTER JULY SELLOFF — FIVE INSTITUTIONS AGREE: Goldman, HSBC, State Street, UBS and BofA Hold or Raise Medium-Term Targets
snippet: GoldSilver.com compiles post-selloff commentary from five major financial institutions — Goldman Sachs, HSBC, State Street, UBS, and Bank of America — all of which maintained or upgraded medium-term gold price targets in the $4,600–$5,500/oz range following the steepest six-month correction in mid-July, citing record central bank purchases in early 2026, gold now representing 27% of global official reserves (surpassing US Treasuries' 22% share for the first time in modern records), and structural diversification by sovereign wealth funds. The institutional consensus frames the July pullback as a tactical correction within a structural bull cycle rather than a trend reversal.

headline: SILVER'S SIXTH STRAIGHT SUPPLY DEFICIT CAN'T OVERRIDE THE FED — 46.3M Oz Shortfall Deferred by Rate-Hike Odds; July 29 FOMC Is the Inflection Point
snippet: Crux Investor examines the disconnect between silver's confirmed sixth consecutive annual supply deficit — the Silver Institute's World Silver Survey 2026 puts the shortfall at 46.3 million ounces, 15% wider than 2025, driven by solar and EV demand outpacing mine supply — and silver's inability to sustain a break above $60 while the Federal Reserve's hawkish committee posture keeps the US dollar bid. The analysis makes the case that July 29 is the inflection point: dovish post-meeting language from Warsh would unlock deferred physical and investment demand; a hawkish hold risks silver retesting $55 before the structural bull case can reassert itself into Q4.
